items.desc_en:
Wasmtime: Bit-packing in Cranelift compiler causes silent overflow and miscompilation
## Summary

In Wasmtime prior to v43, the Cranelift compiler backend bit-packs its SSA value indices in a way that can result in silent overflow in release builds, and result in incorrect value references in the IR resulting in arbitrary miscompilation. A very large Wasm function body, or one that is specially crafted to use many SSA values, can use this to force type-confusion or other arbitrary side-effects and escape the sandbox.

items.summary_zh: 權限檢查缺失導致攻擊者可讀寫或刪除任意配置的儲存庫。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 obsidian-tc 1.3.1 或更高版本。
items.desc_en:
obsidian-tc tokens can access arbitrary configured vaults
### Impact
Tool dispatch did not check the caller-supplied `input.vault` against the caller's bound vault (`ctx.vaultId`); the folder ACL was a single global instance and the JWT carried no vault claim. As a result, **any valid token could read, write, or delete any configured vault** by passing `input.vault`, defeating multi-tenant isolation across ~90 tool sites. (`resources/read` was the only surface that already guarded this.)

items.fix_hint: 升級至 obsidian-tc 1.3.1 或更高版本，並啟用身份驗證。
items.desc_en:
obsidian-tc HTTP transport lacks Origin/DNS-rebinding protection, enabling drive-by vault access on loopback
### Impact
The Streamable HTTP transport was constructed without `enableDnsRebindingProtection`/`allowedHosts`/`allowedOrigins` and performed no `Origin`-header validation. items.summary_zh: Google SSO 驗證缺陷，停用用戶可繞過限制登入管理介面。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 Snipe-IT 8.6.3 或更高版本。
items.desc_en: Snipe-IT before 8.6.3 contains an authentication bypass in GoogleAuthController::handleGoogleCallback, which logs in the user whose username matches the Google account email without enforcing the activated flag. Deactivated users with email-shaped usernames and still-live Google identities can sign in via Google SSO and regain sessions at their original permission level, including admin.
